Verdict: **REQUEST CHANGES** — current-head validation is incomplete at `0e1ca1206f01818318ef44e9919e12e343058b03`.

The one-line change forwards the optional session token without altering the access-key/secret requirements. I checked the client cache, availability checks, test isolation, both new credential-option tests, and the exact dependency locked in `yarn.lock` (`@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock` 5.0.11). Its [published implementation](https://unpkg.com/@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock@5.0.11/dist/index.js) chooses `options.sessionToken` when both explicit keys are supplied, confirming the reported bug and this fix. The [official provider documentation](https://ai-sdk.dev/providers/ai-sdk-providers/amazon-bedrock) documents the optional setting. No additional code defect was identified; no public API, schema, event, ACL, or dependency changes are introduced.

**Critical / blocker — current-head build/test validation has not run.** The [CI workflow](https://github.com/open-mercato/open-mercato/actions/runs/41655576159) is `action_required`. Successful `label` is the only completed reported check; it does not validate this SDK option or the new regressions. A maintainer must authorize fork CI and obtain usable build/typecheck/test results before approval. The author's 13 passing tests used stubbed SDKs outside the monorepo gate and were not independently reproduced here. This is a validation-evidence blocker, not an observed test failure.

**CI pending:** [`license/cla`](https://cla-assistant.io/open-mercato/open-mercato?pullRequest=8618) is still PENDING. Pending is not a failure and does not drive this verdict; the author must complete the CLA requirement. No approval or merge is authorized while required checks remain outstanding. Since progress requires author/maintainer action, this sweep promises no further CI follow-up and leaves no monitoring claim.

Yarn is unavailable (`ENOENT`) and this checkout has no `node_modules`, so `embedding.test.ts` could not be run here. `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed. # 🔍 Re-review: Bedrock temporary credentials

## Verdict
✅ **approve — code assessment**, exact head `0e1ca1206f01818318ef44e9919e12e343058b03`, target `main`. Real hosted validation remains a separate merge gate.

The complete two-file diff forwards `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN` to the existing Bedrock client and adds present/absent-token regressions. I inspected the exact head in an isolated worktree, its client cache and availability checks, test environment restoration, the fresh main implementation, and the installed/locked `@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock` 5.0.11 implementation. With explicit access key and secret, that SDK uses `options.sessionToken` rather than reading the token from the environment. The added option fixes that boundary; long-lived credentials retain `undefined`.

No source blocker, major, minor or nit remains. Existing key/secret requirements, default region, cache behavior, platform authorization/tenant scope, API/schema, dependencies and public signatures are unchanged. Fresh main still lacks this forwarding, so the fix retains value. `git diff --check` passed.
